### Bigrams

Do bigrams capture additional information relevant to the classification of interest? Answer the question, **briefly** describe what analysis you conducted to arrive at your answer, and provide quantitative evidence supporting your answer.

The bigrams do capture additional information that is relevant to the classification of interest, being whether a website contains a claim or not. First, I fit a logistic principal-component regression of only word-level TF-IDF features. This produced an accuracy of ~72.2 percent on the test split.

I then generated bigram TF-IDF features, and reduced them using a PCA in order to fit a second logistic regression using predicted log-odds from the word-only model with the bigram principal components. This model produced an accuracy of ~74.2 percent. 

Because the accuracy from the second regression with bigram features did improve the accuracy of the model, the results suggest that bigrams did capture a small amount of additional predictive information.
